purpose: Teach: 振り込み/括弧/持ち物/鋭意/即刻/告示/第一線/積算

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、給与の振り込みを月末に固定しろ
lines.en: Lock the salary transfer to the end of the month.
lines.style: Firm, decisive opening. Clipped cadence. Authority without harshness. Each word lands with clear intent. Eyes forward, no room for negotiation, but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。括弧書きの注釈を契約書に追加しました
lines.en: Yes. I've added the annotations in parentheses to the contract.
lines.style: Composed, professional. Voice steady and even. Slight acknowledgment of completion in the rhythm. Respectful but not obsequious. Clear confidence in the work done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の持ち物検査は最低限にしろ
lines.en: Keep personal belongings checks to the bare minimum.
lines.style: Measured tone. Deliberate pause before the directive. Lean into 'minimum' with quiet emphasis. This is a principled instruction, not arbitrary. Shoulders back slightly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新プロジェクトに鋭意取り組んでおります
lines.en: Yes. We're pressing ahead on the new project with full effort.
lines.style: Earnest, forward-leaning energy. Slight lift on 'pressing ahead' — showing enthusiasm within formality. Steady eye contact. Reassuring without being casual.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、品質問題には即刻対応しろ
lines.en: Respond immediately to any quality issues that come up.
lines.style: Sharp, alert tone. Urgency without aggression. Crisp consonants on 'respond' and 'immediately.' Leans slightly forward. This is non-negotiable and everyone knows it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新店舗開業の告示を地域に出しました
lines.en: Yes. I've published the announcement about the new store opening to the local area.
lines.style: Factual, matter-of-fact delivery. Smooth completion of task. No flourish, but quiet pride in thoroughness. Even rhythm, professional closure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界第一線の社員を表彰しろ
lines.en: Recognize and award the staff who are leading the industry.
lines.style: Authoritative but warm undertone. Slight softness on 'recognize' — this is about people, not just procedure. Conviction steady. A rare positive directive from the boss.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。費用の積算根拠を資料に明記しました
lines.en: Yes. I've made the cost estimates and their basis clear in the documentation.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Calm, assured tone. Slight settling-in quality — this closes the exchange. Professional and complete. The right person wrapping up efficiently.
